status: Q-learning agent complete — from theory to working agent
key_finding: Tabular Q-learning converges to near-optimal policy in gridworld MDP. With 2000 episodes, agent achieves 99.6% success rate, avg reward 0.78 (optimal ~0.84 for 4x4 grid). Q-value RMS error 0.032 shows convergence toward optimal Q*. The epsilon decay schedule critically impacts convergence — too fast and agent gets stuck in local optima, too slow and learning is noisy. Value iteration provides ground truth for validation.
